panels.description: White-and-amber nodes activate across the civic hall without forming a face or body. Leave upper space for the system tone.
A display requests a designated human authority. Keep the administrative text unobstructed.
Mera opens a cabinet and removes an old authorization lever while Alex and Ada watch. Leave upper space.
The lever plate reads SINGLE AUTHORITY. Alex looks toward the affected residents beyond it; leave upper area.

items.text:
LEGACY AUTHORITY TRANSFER REQUIRED
DESIGNATED HUMAN AUTHORITY: UNASSIGNED
